summary: BJØRUNGS INVEST AS (org. no. 990 514 011) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2007-02-19. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 63 000 and net income was -NOK 58 547. CEO: Odd Gunnar Bjørung; board chair: Odd Gunnar Bjørung.
